title: Telling Stories
description: Membuat kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan past simple dengan did/didn't, mengurutkan cerita dengan first, then, after that, finally, serta menggabungkan kalimat dengan and, but, so, because.
objectives: Membuat kalimat negatif past simple dengan didn't + kata kerja dasar
Bertanya tentang masa lalu dengan Did...? dan pertanyaan wh-
Menceritakan kisah sederhana dengan and, but, so, dan because

lessons.title: Past Simple Negative: didn't
lessons.summary: Membuat kalimat negatif past simple dengan didn't + kata kerja bentuk dasar.
objectives: Membentuk kalimat negatif dengan didn't + base verb
Membedakan didn't (kata kerja biasa) dan wasn't/weren't (to be)
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Pola kalimat negatif
Untuk membuat kalimat negatif past simple dengan kata kerja biasa, gunakan **didn't (did not) + kata kerja bentuk dasar** (*base form*).

| Positif | Negatif |
| --- | --- |
| I **watched** TV. | I **didn't watch** TV. |
| She **went** to school. | She **didn't go** to school. |
| They **bought** a car. | They **didn't buy** a car. |

### Aturan emas: hanya satu tanda lampau
*Did* sudah menunjukkan masa lalu. Karena itu, kata kerja setelah *didn't* **kembali ke bentuk dasar**.
- ✓ *She didn't **go***
- ✗ *She didn't **went***
- ✗ *She didn't **goes***

Ini adalah kesalahan paling umum di level A2. Ingat: **didn't + base form**, selalu.

### Sama untuk semua subjek
Seperti bentuk positif, *didn't* dipakai untuk **semua** subjek: *I didn't, you didn't, he didn't, we didn't, they didn't.*

### didn't atau wasn't/weren't?
| Jenis kalimat | Negatif | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Kata kerja biasa (go, eat, see...) | **didn't** + base | *I didn't sleep well.* |
| To be (was/were) + adjective/tempat | **wasn't / weren't** | *I wasn't tired.* |

Jangan gabungkan keduanya: ✗ *I didn't was tired.*

### Bentuk penuh dan singkat
*Did not* lebih formal (sering dipakai dalam tulisan resmi). Dalam percakapan sehari-hari, orang hampir selalu berkata **didn't** /ˈdɪdnt/.

### Tips untuk penutur bahasa Indonesia
Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita cukup menambahkan *tidak*: *Saya tidak pergi.* Dalam bahasa Inggris, kita butuh kata bantu **didn't**, dan kata kerjanya kembali ke bentuk dasar: *I didn't go.*

lessons.title: Did You...? Yes/No Questions
lessons.summary: Bertanya dan menjawab pertanyaan yes/no dalam past simple.
objectives: Membuat pertanyaan Did + subject + base verb
Menjawab dengan short answer: Yes, I did / No, I didn't
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Pola pertanyaan yes/no
Untuk bertanya tentang masa lalu dengan kata kerja biasa, letakkan **Did** di awal kalimat:

**Did + subject + base verb + ...?**

| Kalimat positif | Pertanyaan |
| --- | --- |
| You **enjoyed** the film. | **Did** you **enjoy** the film? |
| She **went** to Bali. | **Did** she **go** to Bali? |
| They **met** the manager. | **Did** they **meet** the manager? |

Sama seperti kalimat negatif, kata kerja setelah *did* **kembali ke bentuk dasar**: *Did she go?* (bukan ~~Did she went?~~)

### Jawaban singkat (short answers)
| Pertanyaan | Ya | Tidak |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Did you...? | Yes, I **did**. | No, I **didn't**. |
| Did he/she...? | Yes, he/she **did**. | No, he/she **didn't**. |
| Did they...? | Yes, they **did**. | No, they **didn't**. |

Jawaban singkat **tidak mengulang** kata kerja utama: ✗ *Yes, I enjoyed.* ✓ *Yes, I did.*

### Did atau Was/Were?
Ingat pelajaran Unit 1. Gunakan **Was/Were** untuk *to be*, dan **Did** untuk kata kerja lain:
- *Were you tired?* — *Yes, I was.*
- *Did you sleep well?* — *Yes, I did.*

✗ *Did you tired?* — kalimat ini tidak punya kata kerja.

### Intonasi
Pertanyaan yes/no biasanya diucapkan dengan nada **naik** di akhir: *Did you enjoy it? ↗*

### Tips percakapan
Setelah jawaban singkat, tambahkan informasi agar percakapan berlanjut:
- *Did you go out last night?* — *Yes, I did. I went to a concert with my sister.*
- *Did you finish the report?* — *No, I didn't. I was too busy.*

lessons.title: Wh- Questions in the Past
lessons.summary: Bertanya dengan where, when, what, who, why, dan how dalam past simple.
objectives: Membuat pertanyaan subjek tanpa did: Who called? What happened?
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Pola pertanyaan wh-
Untuk mendapatkan informasi (bukan sekadar ya/tidak), letakkan kata tanya sebelum *did*:

**Question word + did + subject + base verb + ...?**

| Kata tanya | Contoh | Arti |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Where** | Where did you go? | Ke mana kamu pergi? |
| **When** | When did she arrive? | Kapan dia tiba? |
| **What** | What did they eat? | Apa yang mereka makan? |
| **Who** | Who did you meet? | Siapa yang kamu temui? |
| **Why** | Why did he leave early? | Kenapa dia pulang lebih awal? |
| **How** | How did you travel? | Bagaimana kamu bepergian? |
| **What time** | What time did the film start? | Jam berapa filmnya mulai? |
| **How long** | How long did you stay? | Berapa lama kamu tinggal? |

### Pertanyaan subjek (tanpa did)
Jika kata tanya **who** atau **what** adalah **pelaku** (subjek) kegiatan, kita **tidak** memakai did, dan kata kerjanya tetap dalam bentuk lampau:

| Pertanyaan objek (pakai did) | Pertanyaan subjek (tanpa did) |
| --- | --- |
| **Who did you call?** (Siapa yang *kamu* telepon?) | **Who called you?** (Siapa yang menelepon *kamu*?) |
| **What did you see?** (Apa yang kamu lihat?) | **What happened?** (Apa yang terjadi?) |

Cara mudah mengingat: jika jawabannya adalah **pelaku** (*Rina called me*), jangan pakai did.

### Pertanyaan dengan to be
Ingat, untuk *to be* gunakan was/were tanpa did: *Where **were** you? How **was** the trip?*

### Kesalahan umum
Orang Indonesia sering membuat pertanyaan dengan urutan kalimat biasa: ✗ *Where you went?* Dalam bahasa Inggris, **did** wajib ada dan kata kerjanya kembali ke bentuk dasar: ✓ *Where did you go?*

### Tips
Saat temanmu bercerita, tunjukkan minat dengan pertanyaan lanjutan: *Who did you go with? What did you do there? How was the food?*

lessons.title: Life Events and Sequencers
lessons.summary: Kosakata peristiwa hidup dan kata pengurut first, then, after that, finally.
objectives: Menggunakan kosakata peristiwa hidup: was born, grew up, got married, retired
Mengurutkan peristiwa dengan first, then, after that, later, finally
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Peristiwa hidup (life events)
Saat menceritakan riwayat hidup seseorang, kita memakai past simple dengan kolokasi berikut:

| Life event | Arti |
| --- | --- |
| **was born** (in 1985 / in Solo) | lahir |
| **grew up** (in a village) | tumbuh besar |
| **went to** school / university | bersekolah / kuliah |
| **graduated** from university | lulus kuliah |
| **got** a job | mendapat pekerjaan |
| **moved** to a new city | pindah ke kota baru |
| **got married** | menikah |
| **had** children | punya anak |
| **became** a manager | menjadi manajer |
| **retired** | pensiun |

Kata kerja tidak beraturan baru: *grow → **grew***, *become → **became***, *begin → **began***.

### Sequencers (kata pengurut)
Kata-kata ini membantu pendengar memahami **urutan** cerita:

| Sequencer | Arti | Posisi |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **First,** | pertama-tama | awal cerita |
| **Then** | lalu, kemudian | tengah |
| **After that,** | setelah itu | tengah |
| **Later,** | kemudian, belakangan | tengah |
| **Finally,** | akhirnya | peristiwa terakhir |

*First, we packed our bags. Then we took a taxi to the airport. After that, we checked in. Finally, we got on the plane.*

### Tanda baca
Biasanya ada **koma** setelah *First, After that, Later, Finally*. Setelah *Then* koma boleh dipakai atau tidak.

### Jangan bingung: after that vs after
*After that* berdiri sendiri di awal kalimat: *After that, we had lunch.* Kata *after* saja membutuhkan objek: *After lunch, we went home.* ✗ *After, we went home* terdengar kurang tepat di level ini — lebih aman pakai *After that*.

### Finally vs at last
*Finally* dipakai untuk peristiwa terakhir dalam daftar. Jangan memakai *finally* untuk peristiwa pertama atau di tengah cerita.

lessons.title: And, But, So, Because: Telling a Story
lessons.summary: Menggabungkan kalimat dengan and, but, so, because untuk menceritakan kisah yang runtut.
objectives: Membedakan fungsi and, but, so, dan because
Menceritakan kisah sederhana dengan urutan yang jelas
lessons.completionCriteria: Baca semua bagian materi, tulis cerita pendek, dan raih skor minimal 70% pada mini quiz.

sections.explanation:
### Empat kata penghubung penting
Kata penghubung (*conjunctions*) membuat cerita lebih lancar dan tidak terdengar seperti daftar kalimat pendek.

| Conjunction | Fungsi | Contoh |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **and** | menambah informasi | *I went to the market **and** bought some fish.* |
| **but** | menunjukkan kontras/perbedaan | *The hotel was small, **but** it was clean.* |
| **so** | menunjukkan **akibat/hasil** | *It was late, **so** we took a taxi.* |
| **because** | menunjukkan **alasan/sebab** | *We took a taxi **because** it was late.* |

### So vs because
Ini yang paling sering tertukar. Lihat arah hubungan sebab–akibat:
- **Sebab → so → akibat**: *I was hungry, **so** I made a sandwich.* (Saya lapar, jadi saya membuat roti lapis.)
- **Akibat → because → sebab**: *I made a sandwich **because** I was hungry.* (Saya membuat roti lapis karena saya lapar.)

Kedua kalimat punya arti yang sama, tetapi urutannya terbalik.

### Tanda baca
- Biasanya ada **koma** sebelum *so* dan *but*: *It rained, so we stayed inside.*
- Biasanya **tidak ada koma** sebelum *because*: *We stayed inside because it rained.*

### Pertanyaan Why? dijawab dengan Because
*Why were you late? — **Because** I missed the bus.* Dalam percakapan, jawaban singkat dengan *because* sudah cukup.

### Menyusun cerita
Gabungkan semua yang sudah kamu pelajari di unit ini:
1. **Pembukaan**: kapan dan di mana — *Last year I went to Malang with my friends.*
2. **Urutan peristiwa**: *First... Then... After that...*
3. **Masalah atau kejutan**: *...but our car broke down.*
4. **Akhir**: *Finally, we arrived at night. We were tired, but happy.*

Variasikan kalimatmu dengan *and, but, so, because* — jangan semuanya memakai *and*.

mistakes.wrong: We stayed at home so the weather was terrible.
mistakes.right: We stayed at home because the weather was terrible.
mistakes.why: Cuaca buruk adalah alasan (sebab), jadi pakai because.

mistakes.wrong: Because I was tired. I went to bed.
mistakes.right: I went to bed because I was tired.
mistakes.why: Dalam tulisan, klausa because tidak boleh berdiri sendiri sebagai kalimat; gabungkan dengan klausa utama.

mistakes.wrong: The room was small, and it was very comfortable.
mistakes.right: The room was small, but it was very comfortable.
mistakes.why: Ada kontras (small vs comfortable), jadi pakai but.

sections.summary: **and** = menambah, **but** = kontras, **so** = akibat, **because** = alasan. Ingat urutan: *sebab, so akibat* dan *akibat because sebab*. Gabungkan dengan sequencers untuk cerita yang runtut dan menarik.

questions.explanation: Hujan seharian adalah alasan tidak ke pantai, jadi pakai because.

questions.prompt: Write a short story about a day you remember (a trip, a party, or a bad day). Use First, Then, After that, Finally and at least two of: and, but, so, because.
questions.explanation: Mulai dengan kapan dan di mana, urutkan peristiwa dengan sequencers, gunakan past simple dan was/were, lalu akhiri dengan perasaanmu.

questions.prompt: Match the beginnings and endings of the sentences.
questions.explanation: because = alasan, but = kontras, so = akibat, and = tambahan kegiatan.

questions.prompt: Find the mistake in the sentence.
questions.explanation: Cuaca buruk adalah alasan tinggal di rumah. Untuk alasan pakai because.

questions.prompt: Choose the best reply.

dialogue.speaker: Teacher
dialogue.text: Why were you late this morning?

questions.explanation: Pertanyaan Why? dijawab dengan Because + alasan dalam past simple (missed).

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the correct option: I'm sorry, I ___ my homework last night. I forgot!
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Negatif past simple: didn't + base form (do).

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Complete the dialogue with one word in each gap.
unitTestQuestions.text: A: ___ you see Maria at the party? B: No, I ___. She wasn't there.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Pertanyaan dengan kata kerja see → Did you see...? Jawaban singkat negatif: No, I didn't.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Ask a question about the time.
answers: When did they move to Semarang?

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Drag the correct words into the gaps.
unitTestQuestions.text: ___, I washed the vegetables. ___ that, I cooked the soup. ___, we ate together.

unitTestQuestions.explanation: Setelah did, kata kerja kembali ke bentuk dasar: enjoy.

unitTestQuestions.prompt: Choose the best word: The tickets were expensive, ___ we bought them. We really wanted to see the show.
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Ada kontras: mahal, tetapi tetap dibeli. Kontras → but.

answers: Why did you not come yesterday?
unitTestQuestions.explanation: Why + didn't + you + come (bentuk dasar) + yesterday?
